_doc: Warnings `lint-skill --strict` raises that this repo accepts, by (rule, file, count). Read by lint_skill_gate.py. SHRINK-ONLY: every entry must still fire exactly `count` times under the pinned CLI, or the gate reds and the entry is lowered or removed. A new rule, file or site is never added here to make CI green; it is fixed, or accepted with its reason in a reviewed change.

accepted.reason: SKILL.md is over the ~19,000 B re-attach cap on purpose. CLAUDE.md records the measured decision: compaction is ~1.6% of transcripts, truncation is head-preserving and a directory-owning skill is recoverable, and front-loading a survival core was withdrawn because the window is fixed-size. Shrinking every body below the cap needs an e2e A/B.
